'''Labaron Dewayne Philon Jr.''' (born November 24, 2005) is an American [[basketball]] player for the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama Crimson Tide]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Labaron Philon Jr. Becomes Fifth First-Round Pick of Nate Oats Era |url=https://www.si.com/college/alabama/basketball/labaron-philon-jr-becomes-fifth-first-round-pick-nate-oats-era |website=SI.com |access-date=June 24, 2026 |date=June 23, 2026|last=De Siver|first=Hunter}}</ref>

==Early life and high school career==
Philon was born on November 24, 2005 in [[Mobile, Alabama]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Smarr |first=Emilee |title=What makes Alabama guard Labaron Philon one of the 'best freshmen' in college basketball |url=https://www.tuscaloosanews.com/story/sports/college/sec/2024/11/26/alabama-basketball-labaron-philon-one-of-the-best-freshmen-in-college-hoops/76604278007/ |access-date=December 16, 2025 |website=The Tuscaloosa News |language=en-US}}</ref> He attended [[Baker High School (Alabama)|Baker High School]] in [[Mobile County, Alabama|Mobile County]] where he played three seasons and scored a total of 2,334 points, being a two-time recipient of the Class 7A Player of the Year award.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/5455838/2024/04/28/alabama-basketball-recruiting-labaron-philon/|website=[[The Athletic]]|title=Alabama basketball adds 4-star guard Labaron Philon|date=April 28, 2024|author=Smith|first=Kennington III|via=The New York Times}}</ref> As a [[Junior (education year)|junior]] for Baker, he averaged 35 points, 6.2 rebounds and 3.9 assists per game, being named the [[Alabama Mr. Basketball]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.al.com/sports/2023/06/reigning-mr-basketball-labaron-philon-transferring-to-link-academy.html|title=Reigning Mr. Basketball Labaron Philon transferring to Link Academy|date=June 17, 2023|author=Thomas, Ben|website=al.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.montgomeryadvertiser.com/story/sports/college/sec/2024/11/26/alabama-basketball-labaron-philon-one-of-the-best-freshmen-in-college-hoops/76604278007/|newspaper=[[The Montgomery Advertiser]]|title=What makes Alabama guard Labaron Philon one of the 'best freshmen' in college basketball|author=Smarr, Emilee|date=November 26, 2024}}</ref> He transferred to [[Link Academy (Missouri)|Link Academy]] in Missouri for his [[Senior (education)|senior]] season.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wkrg.com/sports/baker-high-school-basketball-star-labaron-philon-transferring-to-link-academy/|publisher=[[WKRG-TV]]|title=Baker High School basketball star Labaron Philon transferring to Link Academy |date=June 19, 2023|author=Mathangani, Gerhard}}</ref> He helped Link achieve a top-10 ranking nationally with an appearance in the national semifinals.<ref name="auto"/> Philon also played in the [[Nike Elite Youth Basketball League]] (EYBL), appearing in 12 games and averaging 11.7 points and 4.3 assists.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/40012532|publisher=[[ESPN]]|title=Sources: Top-30 recruit Labaron Philon to decommit from Kansas|author=Borzello, Jeff|date=April 23, 2024|access-date=June 26, 2026}}</ref>

===Recruiting===
Philon was ranked the 32nd-best recruit nationally by [[ESPN]] and the fifth-best [[point guard]] recruit by [[On3.com|On3]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://rolltide.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/labaron-philon/12502|publisher=[[Alabama Crimson Tide]]|title=Labaron Philon}}</ref> He initially committed to playing [[college basketball]] for [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]], but later decommitted.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.al.com/auburnbasketball/2023/04/baker-star-mr-basketball-labaron-philon-decommits-from-auburns-2024-class.html|website=[[AL.com]]|title=Baker star, Mr. Basketball Labaron Philon decommits from Auburn’s 2024 class|date=April 21, 2023|author=Green, Tom}}</ref> He later signed a letter of intent to play for [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]], but decided not to play with them either.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article287958670.html|newspaper=[[Kansas City Star]]|title=Kansas signee Labaron Philon, No. 30-ranked recruit, asks out of Letter of Intent|author=Bedore, Gary|date=April 23, 2024}}</ref> He committed to [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]] on April 28, 2024.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.al.com/alabamabasketball/2024/04/labaron-philon-former-mr-basketball-flips-from-kansas-to-alabama.html|website=[[AL.com]]|title=Labaron Philon, former Mr. Basketball, flips from Kansas to Alabama|author=Alvarez, Nick|date=April 28, 2024}}</ref>

==College career==
Philon impressed with Alabama as a [[freshman]] in the 2024–25 season, averaging 12.1 points on 51.4% shooting in his first 16 games.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.tuscaloosanews.com/story/sports/college/sec/2024/10/30/alabama-basketball-freshman-labaron-philon-talks-early-success/75825739007/|newspaper=[[The Tuscaloosa News]]|title=Alabama basketball freshman Labaron Philon finding way on veteran-stacked roster|date=October 30, 2024|author=Sparr, Emilee}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.al.com/alabama/2024/10/its-been-fun-labaron-philon-already-shining-in-return-to-home-state.html|website=[[AL.com]]|title=‘It’s been fun’: Alabama basketball's Labaron Philon already shining in return to home state|date=October 29, 2024|author=Ashworth, Thomas}}</ref> Following the season he declared for the [[2025 NBA draft]],<ref>{{cite web |last=Borzello |first=Jeff |title=Bryant, Sorber, Powell, Philon to remain in NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/45151088 |website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=May 16, 2025 |date=May 14, 2025}}</ref> but later withdrew.<ref>{{cite web |last=O'Donnell |first=Pat |title=Labaron Philon withdraws name from 2025 NBA Draft, returning to Alabama |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/article/labaron-philon-withdraws-name-2025-040027397.html |website=[[Yahoo]] |access-date=May 31, 2025 |date=May 29, 2025}}</ref> On April 7, 2026, Philon announced his declaration to the [[2026 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web
 |title=Alabama guard Labaron Philon to enter NBA Draft
 |url=https://www.cbs42.com/sports/alabama/alabama-guard-labaron-philon-to-enter-nba-draft/
 |website=[[KJNB-CD|CBS 42]]
 |access-date=April 13, 2026
}}</ref><ref>{{cite web
 |title=from the backyard to the biggest stage
 |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DW10DexFNuV
 |website=[[Instagram]]
 |access-date=April 13, 2026
}}</ref>

==Professional career==
On June 23, 2026, Philon was selected by the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] with the 22nd overall pick in the [[2026 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite news |last=De Siver |first=Hunter |title=Labaron Philon Jr. Becomes Fifth First-Round Pick of Nate Oats Era |url=https://www.si.com/college/alabama/basketball/labaron-philon-jr-becomes-fifth-first-round-pick-nate-oats-era |work=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=June 23, 2026 |access-date=June 23, 2026}}</ref>
